generic_sampling_rules.int_primary_key: Sequential integers starting at 1, unique per table; never NULL.
generic_sampling_rules.int_foreign_key: Sample from the parent table's generated primary-key values; include at least one child row per parent where the join pattern requires it, and leave some parent rows without children.
generic_sampling_rules.int_quantity: Positive integers in [1, 500]; include boundary values 1 and 2 and one step around any listed literal.
generic_sampling_rules.int_year: Integers in [2000, 2020]; include at least two distinct values per group where a MAX/MIN pattern is listed.
generic_sampling_rules.text_short: Short human-readable strings drawn from a small pool of 3-12 distinct values; allow near-duplicate variants (case, spacing) and a NULL share of 5-15% on nullable columns.
generic_sampling_rules.text_version: Dotted numeric version strings of the form d.d.d.ddd; pool of 4-6 distinct values with duplicates.
generic_sampling_rules.text_date: Day-month strings like '1 January'; keep Open_Year consistent with the month/day where a year is present.
generic_sampling_rules.text_enum: Draw from an explicit small enum listed in per_column_exceptions.
generic_sampling_rules.null_rule: Every nullable column gets at least one NULL row per instance; NULL share follows the compact database share (0% observed, so use 5-10% to exercise NULL logic); planted NULLs are never replaced.

generation_specification.uncertainty: Original stock sample shows Shop_ID values 9 and 11 not present in the shown shop sample; generation enforces FK integrity so all child Shop_ID values come from generated shop rows. NULL shares are set to 5-10% because observed null_rate is 0 but nullable columns must exercise NULL logic. Device.Device text values are heterogeneous (brands and model names); treated as free short text.

issues.issue: Nullability of non-listed columns is inconsistent with the schema vs. spec intent
issues.evidence: The DB schema declares no NOT NULL constraints on any column (device.Carrier, Package_Version, Software_Platform, Applications, shop.Shop_Name, Location, Open_Date, Open_Year, stock.Quantity are all nullable per the CREATE TABLE statements). The generation specification's null_targets list covers device.Applications, Carrier, Package_Version, Software_Platform, shop.Shop_Name, Location, Open_Date, Open_Year and stock.Quantity, but omits device.Device, shop.Open_Date is included. Execution feedback shows 'device.Device: generated rows: NULL 0 / 163' — this is consistent with the per_column_exceptions (Device has no NULL rule) and the spec's null_rule exception, and the feedback note explicitly says NULL 0 lines may be noted but do not block. No blocking defect. NOTE only: device.Device has no null spec entry although nullable; acceptable.
issues.requested_revision: None required to pass. Optionally add device.Device NULL share to null_targets for completeness.

issues.issue: Spec requires 'at least two distinct Open_Year values per group where MAX/MIN is listed' but rows_with_different_values pattern applies to shop, and the Open_Year sampler draws uniformly at random — this generally satisfies >=2 distinct values per shop group only stochastically.
issues.evidence: spec.py build_column 'year' kind: vals = _group_assign(...) then [_year(rng, lo, hi) ...] with rng.randint(2000,2020); with n=12 shop rows jittered, the chance all identical across a group is negligible; execution reports 20/20 instances valid and 35/72 construction pairs separated, no group reported failing. The 'rows_with_different_values' pattern is only listed for shop.Open_Year and no per-group guarantee is encoded, but random draws make it overwhelmingly likely. Not blocking.
issues.requested_revision: None required. Could strengthen by forcing distinct years within shop groups, but not necessary given observed separation.

issues.issue: Some per-column target patterns are not directly enforced by construction (e.g., stock.Shop_ID tie at rank 1 on COUNT(*) DESC and SUM(quantity) DESC; shop.Shop_Name tie on COUNT(DISTINCT stock.device_id) ASC/DESC; aggregate boundary COUNT(*) = 0/1/2).
issues.evidence: Execution feedback: construction_pairs: eligible 72, separated 35, unknown_executions 0. Roughly half the pairs are not separated, indicating some target patterns (ties at rank 1, aggregate boundary exactly at values) are only probabilistically realized via random FK draws and random quantity/text sampling. This is expected for a construction-based generator and does not violate any integrity or semantic rule; missing separation alone is not a generation error per instructions.
issues.requested_revision: None blocking. For higher pair separation, engineer could deterministically plant ties (equal COUNT(*)/SUM(quantity) for top-ranked group) and force aggregate boundary counts 0,1,2, but this is an enhancement, not required.

issues.evidence: spec.py enforces Software_Platform IN ('Android','iOS') via enum; stmt in semantic_rules_and_formulas. Quantity > 0 via _quantity returning >=1. Open_Year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2020 via rng range. Device_ID/Shop_ID > 0 via _next_primary_values starting at compact max+1 (>=1). FK rules via fill_foreign_keys_consistently drawing from compact+generated parent values. Execution: fk_violations 0, not_null_violations 0, pk_duplicates 0. All supported rules hold.

writer.py copies orig_path to part file then appends rows in a transaction; original rows never deleted or modified. cli.py seeds RNG deterministically from seed_base*100003+i. Execution: reproducible=true, 20/20 instances valid, rows_added device 163, shop 237, stock 300, rows_skipped 0; integrity all clean.

plant_nulls plants at least one NULL when share>0; execution shows NULL 20/163 for device nullable text columns, 20/237 for shop, 19/300 for stock.Quantity — all >0, consistent with the interface NULL rule. device.Device NULL 0/163 is permitted (nullable but no planted NULL required to block). FK columns device/stock have null_share 0.0 matching spec (child_rows_with_null_fk: false). PK columns never null.

unresolved_checks: Full separation of all 72 target construction pairs (35/72 separated) was not achieved; this is expected for construction-based generation and, per instructions, missing separation alone does not block a pass.
Tie-at-rank-1 targets for stock.Shop_ID, shop.Shop_Name and aggregate boundary counts 0/1/2 are probabilistic rather than guaranteed; not verifiable per-pair without held-out queries.
